theorems.name: Submission.allard_tc_tangent_plane_dilation
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (C : Varifold N n (univ : Set (Euclidean N))) (s : ℝ) (y : Euclidean N) (T T' : Grassmannian N n) (θ θ' : ℝ), 0 < s → (∀ A : Set (Euclidean N), C.weight (s • A) = ENNReal.ofReal s ^ n * C.weight A) → HasTangentPlane C y T θ → HasTangentPlane C (s • y) T' θ' → T' = T ∧ θ' = θ
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
